scope: Segment 150 field-level rules for the success/failure response to a Segment 149 request

rules.title: Segment 150 contains an indication of success or failure of the Segment 149 Fuel Price Update Request
A Field Separator follows the segment (single trailing separator, per-field placement for fields 1-4 not explicitly documented)
rules.note: PROVISIONAL: mirrors the Segment 136 pattern (less-detailed separator note than its request-side counterpart). Pending SME confirmation (SEG150-SME-001).

rules.title: Segment Type fixed 150, Segment Length 3 digits, Terminal Identifier (echo), Decline Code (Element 26, 2 characters, indicates success or failure); all Device-sourced
